entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hm!? What is this place?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Are those... chains on them?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Is this a prison!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who's captured here?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Technically speaking, I would say it's[n]someone's Shadow...
entries.uk: Строго кажучи, я б сказала, що це[n]чиїсь Тіні...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: They're saying something...

entries.speaker: Male Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: C'mon, don't be out there and come on in.
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, годі стояти там, заходьте.

entries.speaker: Female Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: Don't open the cells, okay? I have no[n]intention of leaving this place!
entries.uk: Тільки не відчиняйте камери, гаразд?[n]Я не збираюся звідси йти!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They feel safe being here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What're you saying? You're being kept[n]in a prison.
entries.uk: Що ви кажете? Вас же тримають у в'язниці.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This reminds me of Kamoshida's castle...[n]They're like the "slaves" we saw there.
entries.uk: Це нагадує мені замок Камошіди...[n]Вони як ті «раби», яких ми там бачили.

entries.speaker: Old Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: That's right... This place is the best in[n]the end.

entries.speaker: Old Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: In the depths within is a system that[n]grants desires...
entries.uk: У глибинах є система, що виконує[n]бажання...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A system that grants... desires?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Something like that exists? Here!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's no use. You can't reason with these[n]people.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They're truly "distorted," just like the[n]scenery here...

entries.speaker: Male Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: You end up searching for stuff or being[n]troubled because you're outside the[n]prison.
entries.uk: Це ж тому, що ви за межами в'язниці,[n]ви щось шукаєте чи мучитеся.

entries.speaker: Male Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: There are things you don't need to know[n]to live on.
entries.uk: Є речі, які для життя знати не треба.

entries.speaker: Old Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: He's right. Things like the details on the[n]system, the locked "Quarantine Cell"...
entries.uk: Він правий. Як-от подробиці про систему[n]чи замкнену «Карантинну камеру»...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Quarantine? Who's locked in there?

entries.speaker: Old Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: Supposedly a great and truly dangerous[n]criminal, but who would want to check[n]a place like that?
entries.uk: Кажуть, якийсь великий і вкрай небезпечний[n]злочинець, але хто ж захоче зазирати[n]в таке місце?

entries.speaker: Old Shadow Prisoner
entries.en: Come now, we don't have to chat like[n]this. Why not come inside?
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, нащо нам отак балакати?[n]Заходьте досередини.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...? Mona?

entries.speaker: Guard
entries.en: Hm? Why are you out and about? Where[n]are your restraints!?
entries.uk: Гм? Чого це ви розгулюєте? Де ваші[n]кайдани!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh crap...

entries.speaker: Guard
entries.en: Removing your restraints is not allowed.

entries.speaker: Guard
entries.en: Outsiders... must be eliminated!
